bin_volume.convention: dV = dQ2 * dx * dz * dpT_h in GeV^3 from the release edge columns; x width capped at x_cap - x_min wherever the bookkeeping x_max exceeds x_cap; the same value is emitted per row in the sidecar CSVs (bin_volume_gev3) and printed in the final table column

_schema: PUBLIC caption profile for the 2026-10-16 CONE-BASIS product. Thin overlay
deep-merged over table_config_cone_2026-10-16.json (same directory), which itself
extends table_config.json. Differences vs the cone base profile:
latex.caption_style = "public" -- plain, externally readable captions rendered
from captions.public in the base config (basis-agnostic by design: the cone
basis travels in the invisible % header comment status lines, not in the
visible captions); the caption_forbidden_tokens hard gate is active.
outputs.out_dir -- the TOP LEVEL of the 2026-10-16 cone product (the binned
public tables, the single report set, and blocks/); the internal-profile
sub-run and the density-form sub-run are rendered from the cone base profile
The numbers are identical in both caption profiles; only the visible wording
(and the active token gate) changes. provenance.json records the effective
merged config and every config sha256 in the chain.

captions._comment: printf-style LaTeX caption templates (literal %% for a percent sign). Placeholders are filled per block. The kinematic-domain sentences follow the release's own SELECTION contract: the first published bins are 0.0-0.05 in z and 0.0-0.5 GeV in pT_h (zlow005/pT5 are path tags, NOT cuts).
captions.factor_basis_noZ: $C_{\gamma\mathrm{Born}}$ from the DJANGOH14 NoZ photon-exchange-only Born sample (releasebin, EMPZ$>45$), WITHOUT $Z$ exchange. Both factors are tabulated in every table ($C_{\mathrm{rad}}$ then $C_{\gamma\mathrm{Born}}$); here $C_{\gamma\mathrm{Born}}$ is the applied factor, and dividing a tabulated cross section by $C_{\gamma\mathrm{Born}}/C_{\mathrm{rad}} = F_{\mathrm{EW}\gamma}$ converts it to the WITH-$Z$ convention.
captions.factor_basis_withZ: $C_{\mathrm{rad}}$ from DJANGOH14 releasebin $(Q^{2}_{\mathrm{esGen}}, x_{\mathrm{es,gen}})$, EMPZ$>45$, xFGen$<0$, WITH $\gamma^\ast/Z$ exchange. Both factors are tabulated in every table ($C_{\mathrm{rad}}$ then $C_{\gamma\mathrm{Born}}$); here $C_{\mathrm{rad}}$ is the applied factor, and multiplying a tabulated cross section by $C_{\gamma\mathrm{Born}}/C_{\mathrm{rad}} = F_{\mathrm{EW}\gamma}$ converts it to the photon-exchange-only convention.

level_sentence_by_mode.noZ: Photon-exchange-only Born level WITHOUT Z exchange: sigma_Born_gamma = C_gamma_born x sigma_raw, C_gamma_born from the DJANGOH14 NoZ photon-only Born sample (releasebin, EMPZ>45).
level_sentence_by_mode.withZ: Born level, c_rad_applied=true: full electroweak Born WITH gamma*/Z exchange; sigma_Born = C_rad x Unfold(data;R), C_rad from DJANGOH14 releasebin (Q2esGen, x_es_gen), EMPZ>45, xFGen<0.

captions.noZ: Photon-exchange-only Born-level inclusive charged-hadron SIDIS cross sections WITHOUT $Z$ exchange, %(charge_display)s, cell %(cell_label)s (%(q2_range)s, %(x_range)s); central values $\sigma^{\gamma}_{\mathrm{Born}} = C_{\gamma\mathrm{Born}} \times \sigma_{\mathrm{raw}}$. Basis: %(method_sentence)s; %(selection_sentence)s %(factor_basis_noZ)s %(sigma_form_sentence)s%(x_cap_sentence)s %(noz_gen_note)s %(status_short)s

noz_gen_note.carry: The DJANGOH14-vs-RAPGAP scheme spread is carried over from the WITH-$Z$ $C_{\mathrm{rad}}$ pair as the systematic proxy for $C_{\gamma\mathrm{Born}}$ (no RAPGAP NoZ photon-only sample exists).
noz_gen_note.drop: The scheme-spread proxy is excluded from the systematic column (no RAPGAP NoZ photon-only sample exists); $C_{\gamma\mathrm{Born}}$ is quoted with its statistical uncertainty only.

public._comment: PUBLIC wording profile, selected by latex.caption_style=public. Plain, externally readable sentences: no internal identifiers, paths, directory names, snake_case names, or status tags; the internal provenance stays in the invisible % header comment. Rendered captions are hard-checked against latex.forbidden_caption_tokens by the caption_forbidden_tokens gate. Placeholders: charge_phrase, q2_range, x_range, sigma_form_sentence, preliminary_sentence.
public.noZ: Cross sections for inclusive production of %(charge_phrase)s in deep-inelastic scattering, for the kinematic region %(q2_range)s and %(x_range)s, tabulated in bins of the hadron energy fraction $z$ and the hadron transverse momentum $p_{T,h}$. The selection requires $Q^2 > 150$~GeV$^2$; only hadrons within the central tracking region, $|\eta_h| < 1.6$, are included. %(sigma_form_sentence)s The values are Born-level cross sections: they are corrected for detector effects and for radiative (QED and electroweak) effects; the correction convention is photon exchange only, i.e. the cross sections are defined without $Z$-boson exchange. Each cross section is quoted with its statistical uncertainty and its total systematic uncertainty. Two correction factors are tabulated for reference: the factor applied in this table (seventh column), which follows the photon-exchange-only convention, and the corresponding factor of the convention with $Z$-boson exchange included (sixth column); the ratio of the two factors converts a cross section between the two conventions.%(x_cap_sentence)s %(preliminary_sentence)s
public.preliminary_sentence: The values are preliminary and subject to change.

sigma_form_sentence.binned: Each entry is the cross section in nb integrated over the corresponding four-dimensional bin; the bin volume is given in the last column of the table. The bin-averaged density (the cross section divided by the bin volume) is a derived quantity that is deliberately not tabulated, and model predictions must be integrated over the same bin volume before comparison with the tabulated values.
sigma_form_sentence.density: The tabulated entries are cross sections divided by the bin volume in $Q^2$, $x$, $z$ and $p_{T,h}$, in units of nb~GeV$^{-3}$; the bin volume is given in the last column of the table, and the entries are a derived view of the tabulated integrated cross sections. For the bins whose upper $x$ edge lies above $1$, only the range up to $x = 1$ enters the bin volume.

public.withZ: Cross sections for inclusive production of %(charge_phrase)s in deep-inelastic scattering, for the kinematic region %(q2_range)s and %(x_range)s, tabulated in bins of the hadron energy fraction $z$ and the hadron transverse momentum $p_{T,h}$. The selection requires $Q^2 > 150$~GeV$^2$; only hadrons within the central tracking region, $|\eta_h| < 1.6$, are included. %(sigma_form_sentence)s The values are Born-level cross sections: they are corrected for detector effects and for radiative (QED and electroweak) effects, with $Z$-boson exchange included in the correction convention. Each cross section is quoted with its statistical uncertainty and its total systematic uncertainty. Two correction factors are tabulated for reference: the factor applied in this table (sixth column), which includes $Z$-boson exchange, and the corresponding factor of the photon-exchange-only convention (seventh column); the ratio of the two factors converts a cross section between the two conventions.%(x_cap_sentence)s %(preliminary_sentence)s
public.x_cap_sentence: In this block the physical range of $x$ ends at $x = %(x_cap)s$; the bin volume given in the last column of the table uses this physical limit.

captions.selection_sentence: $150 < Q^2 < 20\,000$~GeV$^2$, $0.1 < y < 0.7$, $E-P_z > 45$~GeV, current-hemisphere $xF < 0$; inclusive charged hadrons (no species PID); track $|\eta_h| < 1.6$ and $p_{T,h} > 0.15$~GeV; $z$ and $p_{T,h}$ binned from 0.0 (first bins $0.0$--$0.05$ and $0.0$--$0.5$~GeV; the release path tags \texttt{zlow005}/\texttt{pT5} denote first-bin edges, not cuts). An $\alpha \geq 0.2$~rad laboratory-frame electron-cone veto is applied on the reconstructed legs only (imposed after the $e$/V0 truth vetoes, before the matched-fake classification and det.int.\ reroute; cone-rejected matched legs enter the miss row; the generator-level selection is unchanged).

sigma_form_sentence.binned: Entries are per-bin integrated cross sections in nb: each entry is the cross section integrated over the corresponding four-dimensional bin, whose volume is given in the last column of the table. The bin-averaged density (the cross section divided by the bin volume) is a derived quantity that is deliberately not tabulated, and model predictions must be integrated over the same bin volume before comparison with the tabulated values.
sigma_form_sentence.density: Entries are bin-averaged $d^4\sigma/dQ^2\,dx\,dz\,dp_{T,h}$ in nb~GeV$^{-3}$ (per-bin cross section divided by the true bin volume, given in the last column of the table; for the highest-$x$ cell the $x$ width is capped at $1.0 - x_{\min}$). This form is a derived view of the tabulated integrated cross sections.

captions.status_short: PROVISIONAL / not physics-final (see the file header for status caveats).
captions.withZ: Born-level inclusive charged-hadron SIDIS cross sections, %(charge_display)s, cell %(cell_label)s (%(q2_range)s, %(x_range)s), WITH $\gamma^\ast/Z$ exchange (full electroweak Born, \texttt{c\_rad\_applied=true}; $\sigma_{\mathrm{Born}} = C_{\mathrm{rad}} \times \mathrm{Unfold}(\mathrm{data};R)$). Basis: %(method_sentence)s; %(selection_sentence)s %(factor_basis_withZ)s %(sigma_form_sentence)s%(x_cap_sentence)s %(status_short)s
captions.x_cap_sentence: In this block the bookkeeping upper edge $x_{\max} = %(x_max)s$ exceeds the physical limit: the physical range of $x$ ends at $x = %(x_cap)s$, and the bin volume given in the last column of the table uses the capped width $dx = %(x_cap)s - x_{\min}$ (here $%(x_cap)s - %(x_min)s$).

charges._comment: Canonical charge = the release/budget token. crad_token maps canonical->C_rad-table token. display is LaTeX; file_token is used in file names.

columns._comment: semantic name -> CSV column name. Adapt here if a future release renames columns. The 15 budget component columns are auto-mapped: their CSV names ARE the component names declared in systematics.components (no separate mapping needed).

defaults._comment: Values used when the corresponding CLI flag is not given.

density._comment: Density form: sigma_binned / true bin volume = (dQ2 * dx * dz * dpT_h) in GeV^3, giving d4sigma/dQ2 dx dz dpT_h in nb GeV^-3. For any bin whose x_max exceeds x_cap (the S3_x0 cell has x_max = 1.5), the x width is capped at x_cap - x_min per the canonical convention.

expected._comment: Documented cross-check values (from the release/campaign records) with tolerances. null = report-only (gate evaluated, cannot fail). Since the S2' repoint the withZ integrals are the Born release's own summary_totals.json values (additionally asserted hard by the release_meta gate); the noZ integrals are self-derived from these validated inputs (no independent campaign number exists) and were recomputed on the S2' basis; update them when repointing at a new release. previous_factor_tol_rel (0.0 = bit-identical) and factor_ratio_tol_rel drive the factor_columns_consistency gate against inputs.previous_product.

formatting._comment: Number formats. --digits overrides significant_digits (the factor columns keep factor_digits). edge_format is applied to bin edges; a decimal point is ensured. use_siunitx=false keeps plain r columns so the AN compiles without extra packages. The header lists and column specs cover EIGHT columns (TEN in split factor mode): z, pT_h, sigma, stat, syst, C_rad, C_gamma_Born, and the four-dimensional bin volume in GeV^3 as the final column. BOTH radiative-correction factors appear in BOTH table sets in fixed order (C_rad then C_gamma_Born); each factor prints as value$\pm$uncertainty with the VALUE at factor_digits (3) and the UNCERTAINTY at factor_unc_digits (2) significant digits -- two config keys; a single shared digit count is infeasible at the analysis-note text width (the published four-digit sigma/stat./syst. scientific-notation cells alone fix about 168pt of width). Headers wider than their column's data width are typeset as two-line \shortstack stacks with identical text. tabcolsep_pt (null = LaTeX default 6pt, nothing emitted) is written into every shipped block as a width knob.

grid._comment: Expected binning. The code derives expected rows per charge = len(cells)*n_z_bins*n_pt_bins and total = that times len(charges.order). No counts are hardcoded in code.

budget._comment: Canonical 15-component S2' systematics budget (13 central-mirroring components + detint_removal_rel + fakecol_mcstat_rel; published total column total_with_s2prime15_rel). Its nominal_cross_section_nb column refers to the RAW parent (IBU) -- enforced by a gate with a per-method tolerance. c_rad_gen_rel / c_rad_stat_rel are carried UNCHANGED from the emfix-pair recipe: take them FROM THE BUDGET, do not recompute.

crad_noz._comment: C_gamma_born WITHOUT Z exchange (DJANGOH14 NoZ photon-exchange-only Born sample, releasebin, EMPZ>45). UNCHANGED by the 2026-10-10 S2' promotion. bin_index is GLOBAL.

crad_withz._comment: APPLIED C_rad WITH Z exchange (DJANGOH14 releasebin (Q2esGen, x_es_gen), EMPZ>45, xFGen<0). UNCHANGED by the 2026-10-10 S2' promotion. bin_index is GLOBAL (pos: 0..N-1, neg: N..2N-1).

previous_product._comment: Sidecars of the PREVIOUS published S2' table product (2026-10-11, single-factor-column layout). Reference for the factor_columns_consistency gate: the own-convention factor columns of the new product (withZ C_rad, noZ C_gamma_Born; value and total uncertainty) must reproduce these per-bin values EXACTLY (expected.previous_factor_tol_rel = 0), proving that the two-factor column layout changed no published number. Also asserted: C_gamma_born / C_rad == F_EWgamma per bin (expected.factor_ratio_tol_rel). Update these two paths when a newer product supersedes the 2026-10-11 one.

release_born._comment: BORN-level canonical release (c_rad_applied=TRUE, WITH gamma*/Z). CURRENT since the 2026-10-10 S2' detint-fake promotion; its summary_totals.json is the source of the expected withZ integrals and of the release_meta per-charge totals assertion. --release-dir overrides release_dir; the method subdir and CSV name come from here.

release_raw._comment: RAW PARENT release (no C_rad applied) of the Born release; parent of the identity gate and base of the no-Z central values. CURRENT since the 2026-10-10 S2' detint-fake promotion (supersedes the coherent-prior raw release); its own summary_totals.json per-charge totals are asserted by the release_meta gate via per_charge_totals_pointer.

latex._comment: One-shot compile of the wrapper (syntax + width accounting), run only if the engine exists on PATH; reported, never gates. The wrapper mimics the analysis-note page geometry: documentclass_options + wrapper_geometry reproduce the note (11pt, a4paper, margin=2.5cm), so the overfull-hbox count in the log measures fit against the note text width; the log's TEXTWIDTH_PT and the overfull counts are recorded in validation.json compile_check. caption_style selects the caption wording profile: 'internal' (captions.*, historical full-provenance wording, default) or 'public' (captions.public.*, plain external wording). caption_styles_allowed is the validated set. forbidden_caption_tokens: in public style a HARD gate fails if any token appears in any rendered caption line (case-insensitive and backslash-insensitive substring match, so LaTeX-escaped leaks are caught); extend this array for future releases.

outputs._comment: --out overrides out_dir; all other names are relative to out_dir. block/label patterns are printf-style with keys mode, charge (file token), cell (cell label), cellclean (cell label without underscores).

provenance_notes._comment: Verbatim status lines (no printf applied) written into every .tex header comment.
provenance_notes.incl_crad_stat_noz_note: NOTE: in no-Z mode the budget component c_rad_stat_rel is the WITH-Z C_rad MC-statistical component, carried as a proxy; it is excluded by the default sys-mode excl_all_stat.
provenance_notes.noz_carry_note: NO-Z MODE BOOKKEEPING: c_rad_gen_rel is CARRIED OVER from the WITH-Z DJANGOH14-vs-RAPGAP C_rad pair as the scheme-spread proxy for C_gamma_born; no RAPGAP NoZ photon-only sample exists (noz_crad_gen_mode=carry).
provenance_notes.noz_drop_note: NO-Z MODE BOOKKEEPING: c_rad_gen_rel is EXCLUDED from the systematic quadrature (no RAPGAP NoZ photon-only sample exists); C_gamma_born is quoted with its statistical uncertainty only (noz_crad_gen_mode=drop).
status_lines: PROVISIONAL / NOT PHYSICS-FINAL -- analysis-note tables; values to be tweaked.
P-CRAD-LUMI: C_rad exposure provenance FILE-SET-RECONCILED (generator-log-open ceiling since 2026-10-09); C_rad is NOT publication-grade.
Releasebin baseline PROVISIONAL (promotion gate, not publication clearance).
EMPZ>45 convention decision CLOSED 2026-10-09 (GenEmpz>45 retained, release-matched truth contract; no applied table changed).

OBSERVABLE BASIS cone-S2' (alphaveto-cone promotion 2026-10-13, CURRENT): S2' det.int. Class 2 removed RESPONSE-INTERNALLY via enlarged per-reco-bin f_i (removable fraction 0.909618 pooled) PLUS the alpha >= 0.2 rad laboratory-frame electron-cone veto on the reco legs (after the e/V0 truth vetoes, before the z-guard / matched-fake classification / det.int. reroute; gen side unchanged; cone-rejected matched legs flow to the miss row); k_parented charged-K DIF kept as signal; external det.int. subtraction is FORBIDDEN (double removal + keeper violation); coherent body+miss prior computed FROM the cone+S2' variant rapgap31 response (R10-asserted).

Release is raw/no-bgsub with response fake-fraction subtraction only (cone+S2' response-internal RG integrated f_i 11.2335% h+ / 10.8698% h-; no-cone S2' 11.2403% / 10.8737%; superseded pre-S2' scalars 10.7141% / 10.4019%); inherited unsubtracted track-level background is multiplied by the correction factor.
No species PID (inclusive charged hadrons); multiplicities blocked (no DIS denominator).
z<0.05 per-bin xF/EMPZ definition sensitivity is CAVEAT-ONLY since 2026-10-09 (no budget component); S2' per-bin definition sensitivity is carried by detint_removal_rel.

15-component cone-S2' LEG-ENVELOPE budget (2026-10-14): the five detector components (elec_energy, elec_theta, hfs_jes, hfs_rces, hfs_theta) are FULL-CHAIN from the shifted-legs campaign (RAPGAP31 governs; per charge/component the whole per-bin vector of the leg with the larger robust median); tracking_eff_m0p5_rel remains data-side conservative; published total column total_with_cone15_rel (medians 5.8032% h+ / 6.1919% h-).
Mixed-beam validity only; not valid for any per-beam or e- Born target; do not compare against RAD-level MC predictions without the same correction.

STAT SOURCE (IBU) CHANGED vs the superseded 2026-10-11b set: the statistical column is toy_stat_unc_nb = (1000-toy sidecar / L_data) x C_rad (the C4b covariance drop-in chain, equal per bin to the budget ibu_stat_rel), NOT the release-job stat_unc_nb used by 2026-10-11b; BBB keeps stat_unc_nb (no BBB toy chain). On this release the two IBU columns agree to -16.9% .. +27.8% per bin (median -0.5%).

Supersedes the no-cone S2' product highQ2_z005_s2prime_born_public_2026-10-11b; the C_rad / C_gamma_born tables, the 245+245 binning, and the bin-volume convention (dV = dQ2 dx dz dpT_h, x width capped at 1.0 - x_min in the highest-x cell) are UNCHANGED.

release_meta._comment: Cross-checks against the Born release's and the raw parent's own summary_totals.json (paths = release_dir/inputs.release_born|release_raw . summary_totals_filename); per_charge_totals_pointer is .format(charge=..., method=...) applied to the charges tree of BOTH files.

systematics._comment: 15-component S2' budget (13 central-mirroring components + detint_removal_rel + fakecol_mcstat_rel). The DEFAULT systematic column is the quadrature of all components minus the sys-mode excludes (i.e. 13 components: ibu_stat_rel and c_rad_stat_rel excluded, detint_removal_rel and fakecol_mcstat_rel included). noz_crad_gen_mode: carry = reuse c_rad_gen_rel as the no-Z scheme-spread proxy (with an explicit .tex comment); drop = exclude it and quote C_gamma_born stat-only. crad_unc_mode: quadrature = factor unc is stat (+ gen) in quadrature; stat_only = factor stat unc only; split = two separate columns.

component_display.detint_removal_rel: det.int. Class-2 removal (S2' response variant, response-internal)

release_born: PROVISIONAL BORN-LEVEL CANDIDATE (bgsub set R', cone base) -- c_rad_applied=true (DJANGOH14 xFGen<0 release-safe x_es_gen binning [releasebin 2026-10-09], EMPZ>45); pre-unfold set-R' background subtraction (cone-applied e + V0 gen-avg + lowQ2, as packaged, NO rescale) on the cone data vector (cone-basis S2' observable, electron-cone selection) with the empty-bin guard; response fake fraction unchanged and applied exactly once (11.3063% h+ / 10.9326% h- of data_sub'); integrated f_res' on D_cone 7.1686% h+ / 7.3886% h-; E1b variance recorded, toy/released statistical input Poisson-only (w2 = data_sub'); multiplicities blocked (no DIS denominator); not physics-final; gate pending (26 items); do not compare against RAD-level MC predictions without the same correction.
release_raw: PROVISIONAL DIAGNOSTIC IBU+BBB -- bgsub_setRprime_conebase: pre-unfold Set R' subtraction (cone-applied electron template AS PACKAGED, no rescale + V0 generator-average + lowQ2) on the CONE-basis S2' variant chain, response fake fraction unchanged and applied exactly once; no C_rad, not Born-level, no final physics approval; multiplicities blocked (no DIS denominator). Prior basis: cone body+miss response truth marginal. Observable basis: cone-basis S2' (bgsub_setRprime data vector). bgsub status: Set R' e+V0+lowQ2. Cone-selection flag: alpha >= 0.2 rad lab-frame electron cone (reco legs only).

release_summary_totals.bgsub_mode_label: OFFICIAL build (built from the official re-unfold output; still CANDIDATE ONLY)
release_summary_totals.raw_yield_vs_born_cross_section_warning: YIELD POLICY CHOICE A (inherited): the *_total_yield and *_median_yield keys are RAW data-level unfolded counts of the set-R'-subtracted data vector (cone base), while the *_total_nb keys are BORN-level cross sections (per-bin C_rad applied). lumi_nb = 351000.0 nb^-1 is the data luminosity. yield = cross_section_nb x lumi_nb does NOT hold in this Born candidate. To recover the raw-level relation divide the Born cross section by C_rad(bin) x lumi_nb.
